description: This file defines middleware functions for security-related HTTP handling in a Node.js/Express application. It includes CORS configuration, Helmet middleware setup, and rate limiting, with dynamic configuration based on environment variables.

methods.name: toOriginMaybe
methods.description: Normalizes a URL-like string to an origin (scheme://host[:port]) or returns null if invalid.

methods.name: corsMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns a CORS middleware with a dynamically computed whitelist based on environment variables.

methods.name: helmetMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns a Helmet middleware with relaxed Content Security Policy and cross-origin resource policy.

methods.name: rateLimiter
methods.description: Builds and returns a rate limiting middleware with configurable window and max requests, with optional skipping for GET requests.
